processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: Scheduler that lists the landing bucket, reads files, and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: Transform job that normalizes claim records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.

data_stores.notes: Analyst access is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

assumptions.assumption: The insurance partner is an external system because it is a separate partner that pushes files into the pipeline.
assumptions.basis: The source describes three insurance partners supplying extracts to the system.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web interface because it is a scheduler executing a batch pipeline.
assumptions.basis: It wakes at a scheduled time, lists a bucket, reads files, and triggers jobs.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web interface because it is a batch transformation job.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a Spark transform job processing files.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket data is confidential because it contains claim records with member names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are health and personally identifying claim data.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database data is confidential because it contains connection strings and partner keys.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are credentials and secrets.

assumptions.assumption: BigQuery data is confidential because it contains claim records with member-identifying columns.
assumptions.basis: The source states that normalized claim records are loaded there and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

assumptions.assumption: SFTP provides intrinsic encryption in transit for the partner-to-bucket flow.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly described as using SFTP.
